name: Kwado (Nigerian Cassava Flour Salad)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mash the smoked fish in a bowl.
Add the garri, ground kuli kuli, sliced onions, salt, and dry pepper.
Stir the ingredients together and serve.

culture.text: Kwado, also called coldmeal, is a Nigerian meal consumed primarily by students in boarding houses. It is prepared without cooking, hence the name 'coldmeal'.
